name: Tigbalang
description: A tall, shadowy forest phantom that leads travelers astray; and how it later got a horse's head.
sources: Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589), in Emma H. Blair and James A. Robertson, eds., The Philippine Islands, 1493–1898, vol. 7 (Arthur H. Clark, 1903)
William Henry Scott, Barangay: Sixteenth-Century Philippine Culture and Society (Ateneo de Manila University Press, 1994)
Maximo D. Ramos, The Creatures of Philippine Lower Mythology (University of the Philippines Press, 1971)

lore.en: Juan de Plasencia, writing about the Tagalogs in 1589, recorded the tigbalang among the beings people feared: a phantom of the forest that appears to travelers and leads them astray, so they walk in circles. Turning one's shirt inside out was later said to break the spell. The familiar picture of a tall creature with a horse's head and hooves (the 'tikbalang') belongs to later folklore: there were no horses in the islands before the Spanish brought them. The game uses the older name and shows a tall, shadowy figure among the trees.
lore.fil: Itinala ni Juan de Plasencia, na sumulat tungkol sa mga Tagalog noong 1589, ang tigbalang sa mga nilalang na kinatatakutan: isang multo ng gubat na nagpapakita sa mga manlalakbay at inililigaw sila hanggang paikot-ikot. Sa mas huling panahon, sinasabing nasisira ang engkanto kapag binaligtad ang damit. Ang kilalang larawan ng matangkad na nilalang na may ulo at paa ng kabayo (ang 'tikbalang') ay mula sa mas huling alamat: walang kabayo sa kapuluan bago dinala ng mga Espanyol. Ginagamit ng laro ang mas lumang pangalan at ipinapakita ito bilang matangkad at madilim na anino sa gitna ng mga puno.

inGame.en: Sometimes a tigbalang leads a few workers astray for a minute. Answer its riddle and they come home at once. It comes more often when the forest is cut too fast.
inGame.fil: Paminsan-minsan, inililigaw ng tigbalang ang ilang manggagawa nang isang minuto. Sagutin ang bugtong nito at makauuwi sila agad. Mas madalas itong dumating kapag masyadong mabilis ang pagputol ng gubat.

hint.en: Something in the forest plays tricks on workers.
hint.fil: May nanloloko sa mga manggagawa sa gubat.
